info.title: goethite API
info.description: Configure and observe a goethite DNS filtering resolver. Every request except `/api/v1/health`, `/api/v1/auth/login` and `/api/v1/auth/reset` needs the admin token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or a session cookie from a sign-in; while the node has neither a token nor users, the API only answers on loopback. Changes are validated, audit-logged and applied at once. Resources have a revision: send it back in `If-Match` to make an update fail if someone else changed the resource in the meantime.

get.summary: The audit log: every change, newest first.

post.summary:
Signs in with a name and a password, and a code when a second factor is
enabled. Answers with the session cookie.

200.description: Signed in; the session is the Set-Cookie

401.description: Wrong name or password, a wrong or missing code, or an expired reset

post.summary: Signs out: the session is gone and the cookie is cleared.
Turns the second factor off; the password confirms it.

204.description: Disabled; recovery codes are gone too

post.summary:
Confirms the TOTP code and enables the factor; answers the recovery
codes, once.

200.description: Enabled; the recovery codes are shown once

409.description: No setup is waiting

post.summary:
Starts setting up a TOTP second factor: answers the secret and the
`otpauth://` URI. Nothing is enforced until a code confirms it. Storing
the pending secret changes the user's record, so the answer carries a
fresh session cookie.

200.description: The secret and its URI; this session continues with a new cookie

409.description: A second factor is already enabled

post.summary:
Changes the signed-in user's password. Every other session of the user
stops working; this one gets a fresh cookie.

204.description: Changed; this session continues with a new cookie

422.description: The new password is not acceptable

post.summary: Finishes a password reset with the one-time token an admin issued.

204.description: The password was set; all sessions of the user are gone

401.description: The token is not valid or has expired

422.description: The new password is not acceptable

get.summary:
This node's cluster: what this node does in it, its leader and members,
and how following the leader goes.

404.description: This node is not in a cluster

post.summary:
Leaves this node's cluster to join another: after a takeover, on a
node of the old cluster. It keeps its configuration until the other
cluster's leader adds it, which then replaces it. Refused unless the
leader of another cluster is reachable, unless forced.

404.description: This node is not in a cluster

409.description: No other cluster's leader is reachable

delete.summary:
Removes a member from the cluster for good, such as a node taken out of
service. Remove it from the leader's config file first, or it is added
again. Made by the leader, like configuration changes.

409.description: It is the leader, or still in the leader's config file

post.summary:
Takes the cluster over: this node starts a new cluster, as its only
voter, with its configuration. For a cluster that has lost most of its
voters for good, such as two nodes without a witness that lost the
leader. Refused while a leader is reachable, unless forced. The other
members join the new cluster once demoted.

200.description: This node leads a cluster of its own

404.description: This node is not in a cluster

409.description: The cluster has a reachable leader

post.summary:
Starts a DNS leak test: names under `leak.goethite.test` that only
goethite answers, for the device being tested to look up. The lookups
that reach this node are recorded for an hour; names that never arrive
were asked of another resolver. Tests live in memory, on this node.

get.summary:
The filter lists goethite recommends, each checked to download and read
cleanly, by category: one base list against ads and trackers, security
lists to stack on it, optional lists by topic, and legacy lists the base
lists include. Lists that do the same job name each other in `excludes`.
Presets are sets of them for a group; the `default` one is what a new
node starts with.

How big the recommended lists say they are, read from the start of each
list by the node when asked, and kept for a day. Lists whose header
states no size are left out.

Clears a user's second factor and recovery codes, as an admin: the way

get.summary: Metrics in the Prometheus text format.

AccessSpec.description:
Which clients are answered, over every transport. An entry is an IP
address, a network in CIDR notation (`192.168.1.0/24`) or a client ID. A
query is answered when its client is on `allowed`, or `allowed` is
empty, and is not on `blocked`. Loopback addresses always pass, but a
blocked client ID is refused even there. Refused UDP queries get no
answer; refused connections are closed before their TLS handshake; a
client ID refused after it is known gets `REFUSED`.

allowed.description:
When not empty, only these clients are answered. At most 10,000
entries.

blocked.description: These clients are never answered. At most 10,000 entries.

Actor.description: Who made a change, and from where.

address.description: The client's IP address, for API requests.

name.description: The user's sign-in name, when a user made the change.

node.description:
The cluster node the change came from or through, when it was not
made on this node.

ActorKind.description: Who made a change: `token` (an API client with the admin token), `user` (a signed-in user, named in the actor's `name`), `unauthenticated` (an API client on loopback while no admin token is configured), `cli` (the goethite command line), `system` (goethite itself) or `replication` (a whole configuration taken from another cluster member). More may be added: show unknown values as they are.

AuditAction.description: What an audit entry records: `create`, `update` or `delete` (a resource or the settings), `import` (the config file's `[filter]` table), `pause` or `resume` (filtering), `refresh` (a list download), `flush` (the answer cache), `replicate` (the cluster's whole configuration, taken from another member), `promote` (this node took the cluster over) or `demote` (this node left its cluster to join another). More may be added: show unknown values as they are.

AuditEntry.description: One entry of the audit log.

detail.description: More about the change, for people.

kind.description: The kind of resource, if one changed.

resource.description: The resource's ID, if one changed.

BlockedService.description: A service a group blocks, always or while a schedule is active.

schedule.description:
The schedule's ID: the service is blocked only while the schedule is
active. Without one it is always blocked.

service.description:
The service's ID in the services catalog (`GET /api/v1/services`),
such as `tiktok`. An ID the catalog does not have blocks nothing.

Category.description: What a recommended list is for.

ChangePassword.description: A password change by the user itself.

ClientSpec.description: A device or network, identified by its addresses or its client IDs.

addresses.description:
IP addresses or networks in CIDR notation, such as `192.168.1.23`
or `192.168.1.0/24`. The longest network containing a query's source
address decides which client asked. May be empty for a client known
by its client IDs only.

ids.description:
Client IDs, such as `anna-phone`: over DNS over TLS, HTTPS or QUIC a
device can name itself, in the server name (`anna-phone.dns.example`)
or the DNS over HTTPS path (`/dns-query/anna-phone`), wherever it is.
A known ID decides which client asked before the address does. 1 to
63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not at either end.

ClusterRole.description: A node's role in its cluster, as goethite 0.4 named it.

cluster.description:
The cluster's ID, if this node is in one: chosen when the cluster
started, or was taken over.

leader.description: The leader, if there is one.

members.description:
Every member: this node, the cluster's other members, and those in
this node's config file; empty from goethite 0.4.

peer.description:
One other member, for clients of goethite 0.4: the leader, or on
the leader another member. Use `members`.

problems.description:
Things someone should look at, in words, such as a member in
another cluster.

state.description: What it does in the cluster; `unknown` from goethite 0.4.

oneOf.description: Off the leader, how following it goes.

term.description: The Raft term: it counts elections.

writable.description:
Whether configuration changes can be made through this node now:
on the leader, or on a member that reaches the leader.

ConfigVersion.description:
Which configuration a store holds.

`epoch` names a line of history: it is chosen at random when a store is
created, and again when a node's whole configuration becomes a
cluster's ([`Store::seed`]). `version` counts the changes along it.
Every member of a cluster goes through the same versions, so a member
that forwarded a change waits until it holds the version the leader
reported.

epoch.description:
The line of history: a random number below 2^53, so it is exact in
JSON.

elapsed_us.description:
Total time spent resolving, in microseconds; divide by `queries` for
the average.

safe_search.description: Sent to a safe search endpoint.

role.description: What the user may do; `admin` by default.

Directory.description: The FilterLists directory, as far as goethite can use it.

lists.description: Lists in syntaxes goethite reads, allowlists left out, by name.

DirectoryEntry.description: A list in the FilterLists directory that goethite can use.

license.description: Its license, as FilterLists records it.

urls.description: Its `https://` addresses: main ones first, mirrors after.

usable.description: Whether goethite can use it: a readable syntax, not an allowlist.

DirectoryList.description: A list's details from the directory, with its addresses.

mirror.description: Whether it is a mirror of another address.

segment.description: Which part of the list it is, for lists in several parts (from 1).

EncryptedStatus.description: How clients reach this node over DNS over TLS, HTTPS and QUIC.

doh.description:
The addresses DNS over HTTPS is served on, at the path `/dns-query`
(or `/dns-query/<client ID>`).

doq.description: The addresses DNS over QUIC is served on.

dot.description: The addresses DNS over TLS is served on.

odoh.description:
Whether the DNS over HTTPS addresses are also an Oblivious DoH
target (RFC 9230): queries at `/dns-query`, keys at
`/.well-known/odohconfigs`.

server_name.description:
The name clients reach it by, such as `dns.example`, if configured:
a client ID goes in front of it, as in `anna-phone.dns.example`.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

memory_bytes.description: Bytes of memory the rules take.

GroupList.description: A list a group uses, always or while a schedule is active.

schedule.description:
The schedule's ID: the list applies only while the schedule is
active. Without one it always applies.

GroupSpec.description: A group of clients with the same filtering.

blocked_services.description:
The services the group blocks, such as TikTok or YouTube: every name
the service uses, whatever the lists say. They apply while filtering
is on.

filtering.description: Whether the group's clients are filtered at all.

lists.description:
The lists the group uses. Custom rules always apply while filtering
is on.

safe_search.description: Whether search engines are sent to their safe endpoints.

Health.description: The answer to a health check.

IssuedReset.description: A password reset an admin issued; shown once.

token.description: The one-time token; goes into the reset link.

LeakLookup.description: A lookup of a test name that reached goethite.

client.description: The known client it was identified as.

filtering.description:
Whether that client's queries are filtered: its group filters and
protection is on and not paused.

group.description: The group whose filtering applies to it.

probe.description: Which of the test's names, from 1.

qtype.description: The type asked for, such as `A` or `AAAA`.

LeakTest.description: A test: the names to look up, and the lookups that reached goethite.

expires_at.description: Until when the test is kept and lookups for it are recorded.

lookups.description: The lookups that reached goethite, oldest first; at most 64.

names.description: The names to look up, in order.

reached.description: How many of the names reached goethite.

requested_by.description:
The address the test was made from, as the API saw it: the device
being tested, when the web UI runs the test in its browser.

LeakTestList.description: The tests this node has, newest first.

ListSpec.description: A filter list: a file on disk or an `https://` URL.

enabled.description: Whether the list is used at all.

path.description: The list file: an absolute path on the node.

url.description:
Where to download the list from: an `https://` URL. Exactly one of
`url` and `path` is set.

download_error.description: Why the last download failed, if it did.

error.description: Why it could not be read, if it could not.

invalid.description: Lines that are not valid rules.

last_attempt.description: When a download was last tried.

last_success.description: When a download last succeeded or found the list unchanged.

rules.description: Rules read from it, if it was read.

unsupported.description: Lines with syntax goethite does not support yet.

code.description: A TOTP or recovery code, when a second factor is enabled.

MemberState.description: What a member does in the cluster right now.

MemberStatus.description: A member of the cluster, as last seen.

oneOf.description: Its configuration's version, when last reached.

error.description: Why the last check failed, if it did.

matched.description: On the leader: the last log entry it is known to hold.

membership.description: How it belongs to the cluster.

reachable.description: Whether it answered the last check.

oneOf.description: What it does, when last reached.

version.description: Its goethite version, when last reached.

witness.description: Whether it is a witness: it votes, never leads and answers no DNS.

Membership.description: How a member belongs to the cluster.

NewPassword.description: A password, set by an admin.

OtpSetup.description: A TOTP secret being set up; shown once.

uri.description: The `otpauth://` URI, for the QR code.

paused_until.description: Until when filtering is paused; absent when it is not.

PeerStatus.description: Another member, as last seen, in goethite 0.4's terms.

oneOf.description: Its configuration's version, when last reached.

error.description: Why the last check failed, if it did.

node.description: Its name; empty when the cluster has no other member.

reachable.description: Whether it answered the last check.

version.description: Its goethite version, when last reached.

Preset.description: A set of recommended lists for a group, in one step.

default.description: Whether a new node starts with it.

QueryEntry.description: One logged query, as the API shows it.

client.description: The client's address (shortened if the log anonymizes clients).

cname.description: For a block through a CNAME, the CNAME target.

elapsed_us.description: How long resolving took, in microseconds.

id.description:
The entry's ID; entries with lower IDs are older. Use it as the
`before` cursor to page.

list.description: The rule's list ID, or `custom` for custom rules.

qtype.description: The type asked for, such as `A` or `TYPE65`.

rule.description: The filter rule that applied, in AdGuard syntax.

upstream.description: For a forwarded answer, the upstream's address.

dropped.description: Entries dropped because the writer could not keep up.

next.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; absent at the end of the log.

badge.description: A short label, such as `Minimal` or `Compatibility`.

default.description: Whether a new node starts with it.

excludes.description:
Lists not to use with it: one includes the other, or they do the
same job. Switch instead of stacking.

license.description: Its license, as the project states it.

note.description: When to choose it, or what to know first.

recommended.description: One of the lists goethite recommends most in its category.

topic.description: For optional lists, their topic, such as `Family`.

RecommendedSizes.description: How big recommended lists say they are, from their headers.

lists.description: The lists whose header states a size; others are left out.

RecordKind.description: The type of a local DNS record.

RecordSpec.description:
A DNS record goethite answers itself, for every client and before the
filter: a device on the local network such as `nas.lan`, or every name
below one (`*.home.example`). A name with records answers only from
them; a CNAME's target is resolved like any other name.

name.description:
The name, such as `nas.lan`, or `*.home.example` for every name below
`home.example` (not that name itself).

ttl.description: How long clients may cache it, in seconds, at most 86,400.

value.description:
An IPv4 address for `A`, an IPv6 address for `AAAA`, a name for
`CNAME`.

RecursionStatus.description:
Recursive resolution: from the root servers down, instead of asking
upstream resolvers.

bogus.description: Answers whose signatures or proofs failed, refused with SERVFAIL.

dnssec.description: Whether answers are validated with DNSSEC.

failures.description:
Client queries that could not be resolved (SERVFAIL), bogus ones
included.

ipv6.description: Whether servers are asked over IPv6 too.

qname_minimisation.description:
Whether servers are shown only as much of a name as they need
(QNAME minimisation, RFC 9156).

secure.description: Answers DNSSEC proved authentic (the AD bit).

sent.description: Queries sent to authoritative servers since start.

timeouts.description: Queries no server answered in time.

ResetWithToken.description: A password reset, with the one-time token an admin issued.

token.description: The one-time token from the reset link.

Role.description: What a user may do through the API.

RoleChange.description: How to change a node's role.

force.description:
Change it even though the cluster seems to disagree: take a cluster
over while its leader is reachable, or leave one without another to
join. Two clusters can result, until one node is demoted.

RuleSpec.description: A custom filtering rule, in any syntax the filter lists use.

ScheduleSpec.description: When something applies: weekly time windows in a time zone.

time_zone.description: An IANA time zone such as `Europe/Berlin`, or `UTC`.

Service.description: A service a group can block.

group.description: What kind of service it is, such as `social_network` or `gaming`.

id.description: Its ID, such as `tiktok`: what groups' `blocked_services` name.

rules.description:
The rules that block it, in adblock-style syntax. Rules goethite
cannot read are left out.

Services.description: The services groups can block, and how the catalog is doing.

downloaded_at.description: When this node saved its copy; `None` until it has one.

error.description:
Why the last download or read failed, if it did; the last good copy
stays in use.

SessionView.description: What a session says about its user.

totp.description: Whether a second factor is enabled.

access.description: Which clients are answered at all; by default, everyone.

blocked_ttl.description: Time to live of null-IP answers, in seconds, at most 86,400.

list_update_hours.description: How often downloaded lists are refreshed, in hours, 1 to 168.

protection.description: The master switch: when off, nothing is filtered for anyone.

StatedSize.description: How many entries a list says it has.

from.description: The start of the first hour covered.

hours.description: Counts per hour, oldest first; hours without queries are left out.

nodes.description: For a cluster's statistics, the nodes whose counts are included.

top_blocked.description: The blocked names asked for most.

top_clients.description: The clients asking most, by client ID or address.

unreachable.description:
For a cluster's statistics, the nodes that could not be asked: their
counts are missing.

api_docs.description:
Whether this node serves its API reference at `/api/docs` (to
loopback clients only).

oneOf.description: The cache, if there is one.
This node's cluster, if it is in one.
DNS over TLS, HTTPS and QUIC, if this node serves them.

paused_until.description: Until when filtering is paused, if it is.

problems.description:
What is wrong with this node, in words, such as filtering running
without its store. Empty when all is well.

protection.description: Whether filtering is on in the settings.

oneOf.description: Recursive resolution, when it is on instead of upstreams.

upstreams.description: The upstreams, in configured order; none with recursion.

SyncStatus.description: How a member follows the leader.

error.description: Why it cannot follow, if it cannot.

last_contact.description: When the leader last sent changes or a heartbeat.

last_copy.description: When this node's configuration last changed.

TopEntry.description: A name or client and how often it was seen.

key.description: The name, client ID or client address.

UpdateCheck.description: The newest published release, next to the version this node runs.

latest.description: The newest release's version, without the tag's `v`.

published_at.description: When it was published, if the release says.

UpdateUser.description: What an admin may change about a user.

healthy.description: False while it is skipped after repeated failures.

UserView.description: A user as the API shows one: never a hash, secret or code.

reset_pending.description: Whether a password reset was issued and has not expired.

revision.description: Counts updates, as an `ETag` on the single-user responses.

totp.description: Whether a second factor is enabled.

Window.description:
A weekly time window. `end` before `start` runs past midnight into the
next day.

days.description: The days the window starts on.

WithCode.description: A code from an authenticator app.

code.description: Six digits, or a recovery code.

token.description: The admin token printed by `goethite token`.
